meta.title: EREBUS — Inside the Cocoon
meta.note: Dive room inside The Chrysalis (growth cycle #3, scheduled run; published 2026-08-12). You stand mid-transformation: amber membrane closing, one teal light still breathing. EGG-004 lives here (renumbered — Purple Rain took EGG-003 first).

stops.title: Inside the Cocoon
stops.body: The amber is closing. The green still breathes — one held light. The ring nearby carries you back.

secret.title: It knows you now.
secret.body: You stood inside a thing mid-becoming and it did not stop for you. Fourth secret. Whatever hatches from this room will remember who watched.
